title: Childhood saucer over football field, Artek camp and army sightings
place_text: Football field; Artek camp near Mount Ayu-Dag, Crimea; Soviet army

tellings.quote: me. You know in childhood when we played football we saw a saucer hovering over the football field a few dozen boys watching it.

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former president of one of Russia's republics, tells Michels that as a boy playing football he and "a few dozen boys" watched a saucer hovering over the field. He tells it as something he saw himself, one of several sightings he describes from his youth, including at Artek, the Soviet children's camp near Mount Ayu-Dag in Crimea, and later in the Soviet army. If true, it was seen by a whole crowd of witnesses, not just one child.
